brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the town of Deir Istiya northwest of Salfit early Friday morning, the Shehab Wire reported. Troops entered the town and conducted searches across multiple residential areas.

Local sources said forces systematically searched homes and interrogated residents on the ground during the operation. No further details on the scale or duration of the raid were immediately available.
